notes.title: Rank: Warmaster News and Updates February 1, 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466477/7534a3e92087542b02590d8eb11fd19eab4fec70.png[/img]
Greetings, Warmasters and Candidates! This is the newsletter for February 1, 2022, the first February newsletter. Most of the updates today are more back-end changes which help the game to run a little smoother or make the task of creating content for the game easier.

[u][b]The Campaign Engine[/b][/u]

The most notable of these adjustments is the implementation of new variables to the campaign engine. The point of this is to allow for the scenarios to be more vaguely defined. This allows us to, for example, have a scenario be physically placed during gameplay relative to a random player border city and spawning all the needed set pieces in unexplored territory, rather than based on strict, pre-defined coordinates. Systems like this are critical to maintaining the illusion that these set pieces where always there, without them having to actually be. We're hoping to have these systems complete soon, and that will allow for the implementation of our first true scenarios to the game.

[u][b]Misc. News[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Matt continues to develop the Corporation Screen, particularly the behind-the-scenes connections needed to make the screen meaningful
[*] Jorden has finished the written draft for "Isolation", one of our most complex scenarios to date, and completed an editing pass, this means that the next step is implementing the scenario in Articy
[*] Adam has been working on the techweb adjustments to allow corporations to have their signature technologies, as well as hidden technologies which would be used by certain scenarios
[/list]
That's all for this update. We understand that much of these changes have little or no visibility for our players, but we wanted to keep you informed as to our current tasks nonetheless. If you'd like to give Rank: Warmaster a try for yourself, pick up a copy on Steam and begin your conquest of Mars!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422270/Rank_Warmaster/

notes.title: Rank: Warmaster News and Updates January 18, 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466477/7534a3e92087542b02590d8eb11fd19eab4fec70.png[/img]
Greetings, Warmasters and Candidates! This is the newsletter for January 18, 2022, our only newsletter for January but our first newsletter of the new year. Happy New Year, everyone! This will just be a quick update, as members of our team are only recently returned from vacation.

[u][b]Updated Default Controls[/b][/u]

One of the long delayed tasks that we've gotten accomplished recently is an update to the default controls for mouse and keyboard play. Our initial controls came about piece by piece as functions were added to the game, but now we've completely reworked the controls to be focused around the WASD keys. This will have the most significant impact when directly controlling individual ships through the Sim Screen. If you've already been playing, we strongly encourage you to reset all controls to defaults (don't forget to hit "Apply" and "Save") when you next load the game in order to test out the new configuration. Be sure to give us your feedback!

[u][b]Misc.[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] We're getting very close to having a game mode which players can select which will actually make use of the Corporation Screen to allow players to choose the starting conditions for their individual corporations and the game at large, early tests have revealed a few strange issues so we'll have more on that later
[*] Paul has been updating the appearance of tooltips
[*] We're making progress on getting our first scenarios actually in to the game, but we can't say much more about that at this time
[/list]

That's all for this update, stay tuned for more come February! If you'd like to give Rank: Warmaster a try for yourself, pick up a copy on Steam and begin your conquest of Mars! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422270/Rank_Warmaster/
